title: hook fast path still pays ~6ms importing argparse: prusik/__main__.py imports it at module level though the hook path never builds the parser
detail: Post-release check of v0.223.0 on the global framework-Python CLI (2026-10-25, -X importtime from a throwaway project): prusik.__main__ cumulative 6.6ms of which argparse 5.8ms, imported at module top even though the exact-argv hook dispatch returns before any parser exists (_slug uses argparse.ArgumentTypeError only when the parser runs). Move  (and  if unused on the hot path) below the fast path / into main + _slug, and add argparse to the hook import guard in tests/test_hook_hot_path.py (assert it is NOT in sys.modules after a pre-tool hook). Same class as the v0.223.0 work; cheap.

thread.body: Correction (shell quoting stripped two backticked phrases from the detail): the remedy reads "Move the module-level `import argparse` (and `import re` if unused on the hot path) below the fast path / into main + _slug".
